links.claim: For XRP Payment settlement, delivered_amount is evidence of what the destination actually received. Checking the requested Amount alone can accept an underpayment when partial-payment semantics apply. Our checks bind destination, currency, amount and invoice identity to the intended purchase. Escrow settlement has its own validation and object checks. Issued-token escrow additionally requires the exact RippleState balance delta, with the correct currency, issuer and sign. A requested amount is never sufficient proof of delivery.
